summary: XBackBone is a lightweight file manager designed for quick uploads and sharing. It integrates directly with tools like ShareX to let you send screenshots and files to your own server instantly.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a dedicated, private endpoint for ShareX uploads without relying on third-party services.
watchOut: It is a niche utility with a moderate community size, meaning you may need to rely on the existing codebase for troubleshooting custom setups.
deployNotes: As a PHP application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for uploaded files and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
